svg.title: Travel Agent Planner concierge architecture
svg.desc: Five prompt agents in Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, all guarded by the same RAI policy as the team: conciergeAgent on gpt-5.6-luna and four subagents on gpt-5-mini for the knowledge base, web search, weather and hotels. The concierge leads a conversation over many turns in one session and has the four subagents as function tools (agent as a tool). When it calls one, the local client runs that subagent as a new conversation that sees only the task and today's date, and sends the subagent's reply back as the tool result. Each subagent has its data tool and a local ask_user tool, with which it asks the user a question about its own topic in the console. The weather and hotel tools run locally against the Visual Crossing and Google Maps Places APIs; the knowledge base and web search run inside Foundry. Before the concierge runs, a scope guard on gpt-5-mini checks every message together with the end of the previous reply. The chat signs the user in, gives the concierge the travel history from Azure Cosmos DB, saves the whole conversation at the end, summarises it with Azure AI Language, sends its traces to Application Insights and reads every setting and key from Azure Key Vault. An evaluation script runs test conversations through the same agents, skips the subagents' questions and scores the final answer and every subagent call with Foundry evaluators.
